propositions: Drain advisory lock is held across LLM calls (437s and 131s observed), making every spawned drain child single-flight and causing a 1,046-entry standing backlog.

Restructure drain() into three phases: _collect_claims (under lock; ~1.5-2.9s), _enrich_claims (LLM calls without lock), and _finalize_claims (store write lock only per append), releasing the lock before LLM processing.

Concurrent drainers must be bounded to 2-3 distinct live-lease drainer_ids via a guard in collect; raise DEFAULT_OVERLAP_DRAIN_BATCH from 5 to 20, clamped to lease_ttl_s // 40 (≈22 at 15-min default).
Stale-at-writeback tickets detected via content_hash snapshot in collect are re-enqueued with soak 0 (immediate retry) and counted as stale_skipped; no stale digest emit occurs.
Lock-acquired-during-enrich instrumented test must succeed for every LLM call in a batch, proving lock is released before enrichment phase.
Concurrent zero-duplicate test: re-entrant drain triggered mid-enrich on 10 tickets must produce exactly 10 LLM calls with each ticket enriched once.
